Lead lane: whispered sleep SCIENCE (How We Know deep sea, food and materials; history secondary, her ruling 6 Nov 2026), 2-3 hour videos, rewritten for sleep from fact-checked How We Know scripts. Backup lane: money and love affirmations, 1 a week, same channel.

Read by loop/whisper_lane.py (scripts, checks, kits, the Mac night step), loop/whisper_author.py (the $0 cloud author) and voice/whisper_voice.py (Chatterbox, on the Mac, inside the batch's narrator lock). Nothing in this file is decoration: every key has a reader.
Fact-checked = uploaded by the How We Know machine (loop/state/ledger.json `published`, not retired): those scripts passed the source, citation and render gates.

9 Nov 2026 (her rulings: "i want to reach monetization fastest", "build the neville lane", then Money and a rotating Shinn slot): four lanes until monetised - Neville technique whispers, Money affirmations, a rotating slot (Florence Scovel Shinn, love, specific person, self-concept) and sleep history - in the weekly `mix`, read by loop/whisper_lane.queue; manifesting videos are 1 hour, history 2 hours. Teaching rules and rights: loop/teachings.py, config/teacher_rights.json.

channel.name: Whisper Almanac
channel.ai_voice_line: The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.

sample.why: Chatterbox conditions on 10 seconds of the reference (voice/synth.py). 20-30 s of steady whispering lets the step pick the cleanest 10 s (synth.pick_voiced_window). Her sample stays on her Mac and never goes in a repo (her call 5 Nov).

voice.why: Lower exaggeration and cfg_weight than the How We Know read (0.4/0.4) for a flatter delivery; measured 6 Nov 2026 the register still spoke at 170 words a minute, so every chunk is slowed to 0.82 (pitch kept, ffmpeg atempo) and the pauses are long. Pauses and the slow-down are added in code: they cost no narration time on the Mac.

pacing.speech_wpm_basis: measured 6 Nov 2026: 170 words a minute from Chatterbox with this register (How We Know test voice), times the 0.82 tempo = 139; re-measured from her own voice on the first voiced episode

lengths._why: Manifesting videos 1 hour (the '1 hr' search term; about half the Mac time of a history episode), history 2 hours (coordinator's correction 9 Nov 2026 from the measured night: 6.8 h of voice + 2.7 h of render for one 1 h 43 min history episode). goal_s: the pause scale the author fits a new script to.

distinct.why: Every video is a distinct script (her call 6 Nov; mass-produced loops risk demonetisation). Overlap = share of a script's eight-word runs found in any other Whisper Almanac script.

titles.why: Benefit, trigger, moment, real length; never 'no ads' (we monetise) and never a promise (risk brain ADV). Lead keywords from free YouTube autocomplete, 9 Nov 2026; 'neville goddard asmr' is a tag, not a lead.

visual.why: Her ruling 6 Nov 2026 (money case): dim, moving footage of the named subject, not a dark screen - the Sep 2026 demonetisation wave hit near-identical dark-screen sleep compilations. The How We Know long-form footage rules apply (a new shot at least every 20 s, no clip repeated within 3 minutes, no subject over ~25%), enforced by visuals/whisper_reel.reel_problems.

brand.why: The manifesting/sleep ASMR brand approved 6 Nov 2026 (one candle in a dark room, dark only; DM Serif Display italic lowercase for thumbnail words, Jost Light for the rest).

episodes.hook: A slow, whispered trip down through the dark ocean: why deep animals glow, why so many are red or clear, how they live under the weight of the sea, and what happens when a whale comes to rest on the sea floor.

A slow, whispered look at the strange animals of the deep sea: why they look the way they do, why some seem frightening and are not, how large a colossal squid really grows, and why deep fish change when they are brought up.
episodes.promise: the strange animals of the deep sea

episodes.hook: A slow, whispered walk through how people learned what they cannot touch: how far away other galaxies are, how old a shell or a stone is, how the dark sea floor was mapped, and how people reached the deepest place on Earth.
episodes.waits_for: footage of its own subjects for every part (galaxies, age dating, sea-floor mapping, Challenger Deep, the Mariana Trench): her call 6 Nov 2026, no part voiced or rendered without it. The nightly harvest grows the pool.
episodes.promise: how we learned about far stars and the deep sea

episodes.topic: science of steel, glass and iron
episodes.hook: A slow, whispered science lesson on the strong things around you: how steel gets its strength, why a blade is plunged into water, what made old swords famous, why some old iron never rusts, and how glass, concrete and the purest silicon are made.
episodes.waits_for: footage: materials holds 8 licence-checked clips; the reel rules need more (visuals/whisper_reel.py). The imagery-harvest lane grows the pool; until then this script is not voiced.

inner-conversation.name: the inner conversation
inner-conversation.title: Whisper method guided meditation for sleep · Neville Goddard's inner conversation ({length})
inner-conversation.promise: the whisper method, from Neville Goddard's inner conversation
points: Neville taught that the words you say to yourself, silently, all day, shape how you see your life.
He asked people to notice that inner talk, and to change it so it matches the wish already fulfilled.
The whisper method many people use today is built on this: you quietly hear, in your mind, the words you would hear if the wish were already true.
You keep it simple: one short, warm sentence, heard as if a friend whispered it to you, again and again, as you drift off.

sats.name: the state akin to sleep
sats.title: SATS guided meditation for sleep · Neville Goddard's state akin to sleep, whispered ({length})
sats.promise: Neville Goddard's state akin to sleep
points: Neville called the drowsy moment before sleep the state akin to sleep.
Your body is still and heavy, but you can still gently guide your attention.
In that state you picture one short scene that would follow the wish fulfilled, and you feel it as real, now.
You repeat the little scene until it feels natural, and let yourself fall asleep inside it.

law-of-assumption.name: the law of assumption
law-of-assumption.title: Law of assumption sleep meditation · whispered ASMR, Neville Goddard ({length})
points: Neville taught that what you quietly assume about yourself and your life tends to show up in how you live.
To assume is to take something as already true, before you can see it.
The practice is to choose the assumption you want, and to keep returning to it, calmly, especially at night.
It is a practice of attention and feeling, not a promise of any result.

living-in-the-end.name: living in the end
living-in-the-end.title: Neville Goddard sleep meditation · living in the end, whispered ASMR ({length})
living-in-the-end.promise: Neville Goddard's living in the end
points: Living in the end means imagining from the moment after your wish is fulfilled, not wishing toward it.
You think from the wish, not of it: you are already there, looking around.
You notice small, ordinary details of that moment, and how calm and settled you feel.
Then you rest there, and let sleep come while you are still inside that ending.

revision.name: revision
revision.title: Neville Goddard sleep manifestation · revision, a whispered ASMR meditation ({length})
points: Revision is a gentle evening practice Neville taught.
Before sleep, you look back over the day and pick a moment you wish had gone differently.
You replay it in your imagination, slowly, the way you wish it had gone, until the new version feels real.
You end the day on the revised scene, kind to yourself, and fall asleep there.

feeling-is-the-secret.name: feeling is the secret
feeling-is-the-secret.title: Neville Goddard sleep affirmations · feeling is the secret, whispered ASMR ({length})
feeling-is-the-secret.promise: Neville Goddard's feeling is the secret
points: Neville taught that the feeling behind an idea matters more than the words.
The practice is to feel, now, how you would feel if the wish were already fulfilled.
Relief, quiet joy, thankfulness: you let one of those feelings fill your chest and shoulders.
You carry that feeling with you into sleep.

self-concept.name: self-concept
self-concept.title: Self-concept sleep meditation · Neville Goddard, whispered ASMR ({length})
points: Neville taught that your idea of yourself shapes the part you play in your life.
Self-concept is simply the story you quietly hold about who you are.
The practice is to choose the self you want to be, and to feel like her tonight, in small, ordinary ways.
You fall asleep as that self, not trying to become her.

bridge-of-incidents.name: the bridge of incidents
bridge-of-incidents.title: Manifest while you sleep ASMR · Neville Goddard's bridge of incidents, whispered ({length})
points: Neville described a bridge of incidents: the ordinary steps that seem to lead from where you are to the life you imagined.
He taught that you do not need to plan every step.
Your part is to hold the end in your imagination and to take the natural next step when it appears.
Tonight you rest, and leave the steps to the days ahead.

imagination-creates-reality.name: imagination creates reality
imagination-creates-reality.title: Neville Goddard sleep meditation · imagination creates reality, whispered ASMR ({length})
imagination-creates-reality.promise: Neville Goddard's teaching that imagination creates reality
points: Neville taught that imagination is where every change begins.
Before anything changes outside, he said, something changes in how you picture it.
The practice is to picture your wish as a small, vivid, finished scene, and to return to it often.
You let the scene be soft and real, and you fall asleep in it.

law-of-prosperity.name: the law of prosperity
law-of-prosperity.title: Florence Scovel Shinn money affirmations for sleep · whispered ASMR ({length})
points: Florence Scovel Shinn taught that prosperity starts as an inner state before it shows up outside.
She asked people to feel rich in mind first: calm, grateful, expecting good.
Her practice was to speak short, bold words of plenty, and to act as if they were true.
Tonight you rest in that feeling of plenty, without counting or worrying.

your-word-is-your-wand.name: your word is your wand
your-word-is-your-wand.title: Your word is your wand · Florence Scovel Shinn sleep affirmations, whispered ASMR ({length})
your-word-is-your-wand.promise: Florence Scovel Shinn's your word is your wand
points: Florence Scovel Shinn believed the words you speak about your life carry power.
She wrote short affirmations for every part of life, and asked people to say them with feeling.
The practice is to choose kind, hopeful words, and to stop repeating words of lack.
Tonight you let a few gentle words carry you into sleep.

divine-selection.name: the right love
divine-selection.title: Florence Scovel Shinn love affirmations for sleep · whispered ASMR ({length})
points: Florence Scovel Shinn wrote about love without fear.
She asked people to let go of worry and of trying to control another person.
Her love affirmations are about peace, warmth and being loved by the right people.
Tonight you rest in that peace.

divine-design.name: your divine design
divine-design.title: Florence Scovel Shinn self-concept sleep meditation · whispered ASMR ({length})
points: Florence Scovel Shinn taught that each person has a perfect way to express themselves, a design that is truly theirs.
She asked people to trust that design and to follow quiet hunches toward it.
The practice is to picture yourself doing what you were made for, calm and at ease.
Tonight you fall asleep as that self.

calm_footage.why: Her call 9 Nov 2026 ("apply the correct footage"): the manifesting lanes never show How We Know's deep-sea creatures. Neville and the rotating lane (Shinn, love, specific person, self-concept) take calm night footage (real night sky, moonlight on water, waves at dusk, rain on a window, candlelight, golden-hour clouds, a forest at dawn); Money takes money and luxury footage (her correction the same day: luxury interiors at night, a penthouse over city lights, a yacht at sunset, a private jet cabin, champagne, gold and jewelry, gold bars, a luxury car interior, shopping bags, an infinity pool at dusk). Real footage only, Pixabay/Mixkit under their free licences, licence wording stored and re-checked, credited in the description (research/imagery_stock_video.harvest_calm); a clip with any word on screen is refused at harvest. History sleep episodes keep their own episode footage. per_subject caps each subject so none holds over ~25% of the screen (visuals/whisper_reel.reel_problems).

picture_gate.why: Whisper Almanac's own final frame check (visuals/whisper_frame_check.py), 9 Nov 2026: How We Know's gate failed every dimmed sleep video because ONE frame of open water out of ~300 failed it. Any frame still hard-fails on text, black bars, a diagram/graphic/CG filler, or a near-black frame (her 6 Nov rule: dim moving footage, never a dark screen; the Sep 2026 demonetisation hit dark-screen sleep compilations). near_black_luma: mean luma (0-255) of the sampled, dimmed frame, measured in code; measured 9 Nov on the held 1 h 43 min render, 42 of 310 frames sat under 6 (black to the eye, e.g. 2.1 at 1:01) while dim footage with a visible animal read 12+. subject_share_min: at least half the sampled frames must show real footage of the named subject; ambient open water, seabed or sky may fill the rest. Start at 0.5; raise it if the subject reads as missing.
